title: Visa pricing - 1-3% interchange plus non-negotiable 0.13-0.14% assessment fee
clean_text: Merchants pay Visa interchange (reimbursement) fees set by published rate tables, typically equal to roughly 1-3% of the transaction amount depending on merchant risk level, transaction value, card-present vs. card-not-present status, and merchant category code (MCC). A separate, non-negotiable assessment fee of approximately 0.13-0.14% goes directly to Visa for network infrastructure and applies to all merchants regardless of processor. As of January 2026, Visa added a 100-basis-point (1.00%) Legacy Surcharge to Level 2 rates for small business credit products, and tightened eligibility for CEDP rates starting October 17, 2025.
